# vfx-mcp — Full Documentation

FastMCP 3.4+ server wrapping FFmpeg for video effects processing.

## Tools

### vfx_apply

Portmanteau tool — 9 video effect operations:

| Operation | Required Params | Optional Params | Description |
|-----------|----------------|----------------|-------------|
| `color_grade` | input_path, output_path, style | — | Apply color grading LUT |
| `transition` | input_a, input_b, output_path | transition, duration | Crossfade/wipe between clips |
| `chroma_key` | input_path, output_path | color, threshold | Green/blue screen removal |
| `overlay_text` | input_path, output_path, text | position, font_size | Add text overlay |
| `overlay_image` | input_path, overlay_path, output_path | position, scale | Add logo/watermark |
| `blur` | input_path, output_path | blur_type, strength | Gaussian or box blur |
| `speed` | input_path, output_path | rate | Change playback speed |
| `crop` | input_path, output_path, width, height | x, y | Crop video |
| `concat` | sources (list), output_path | — | Join multiple clips |

## Return Format

All operations return:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Done",
  "output_path": "path/to/output.mp4"
}
```

On failure:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "FFmpeg error: ..."
}
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Required | Description |
|----------|---------|----------|-------------|
| VFX_MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | No | HTTP bind address |
| VFX_MCP_PORT | 11122 | No | HTTP server port |
| VFX_MCP_FFMPEG_PATH | ffmpeg | No | FFmpeg binary path |
| VFX_MCP_FFPROBE_PATH | ffprobe | No | FFprobe binary path |
| VFX_MCP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS | 300 | No | FFmpeg subprocess timeout |

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/health` — Server health, version, uptime
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — Diagnostics with tool count, FFmpeg availability
- `POST /mcp` — FastMCP streamable HTTP transport
